# AVM (Any Version Manager)

> AVM manages Node.js, Java (Temurin OpenJDK) and Android SDK versions per project, with aliases, environment variables and checksum-verified lockfiles. Open source (MIT) for macOS, Linux and Windows.

## Docs
- [Introduction](https://getavm.dev/docs/guide/introduction): what AVM is and why
- [Getting started](https://getavm.dev/docs/guide/getting-started): install and quickstart
- [Command reference](https://getavm.dev/docs/manage/commands): every CLI command
- [Version files](https://getavm.dev/docs/manage/version-files): .nvmrc, .node-version, .avm.json and more
- [Lockfiles](https://getavm.dev/docs/manage/lockfiles): reproducible, verified installs
- [Comparison](https://getavm.dev/docs/manage/comparison): AVM vs asdf, mise, nvm and others
- [FAQ](https://getavm.dev/docs/more/faq)

## Guides
- [An nvm alternative for Node.js, Java and Android](https://getavm.dev/guides/nvm-alternative)
- [Switch Node.js versions per project](https://getavm.dev/guides/switch-node-versions-per-project)
- [Manage multiple Java versions](https://getavm.dev/guides/manage-java-versions)

- [Plugin marketplace](https://getavm.dev/marketplace): Node.js, Java and Android SDK plugins
